lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ke wisaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with the one I loved.

lines: Agar aur jeete rehte, yahi intezaar hota
couplets.en: Had I lived longer, I would still be waiting.

lines: Koi mere dil se poochhe tere teer-e-neem-kash ko
couplets.en: Let someone ask my heart what your half-drawn arrow did.

lines: Ye khalish kahaan se hoti jo jigar ke paar hota
couplets.en: Would it still ache if the arrow had passed clean through?

lines: Ye kahaan ki dosti hai ke bane hain dost naaseh
couplets.en: What kind of friendship is it when friends take to preaching?

lines: Koi chaara-saaz hota, koi gham-gusaar hota
couplets.en: If only someone could ease the pain, or sit with me in it.

lines: Kahoon kis se main ke kya hai, shab-e-gham buri bala hai
couplets.en: Whom can I tell what this cruel night of grief is like?

lines: Mujhe kya bura tha marna agar ek baar hota
couplets.en: I would not have minded dying if I had only to die once.

lines: Ye masaa'il-e-tasawwuf, ye tera bayaan Ghalib
couplets.en: How well you speak of the mysteries of the spirit, Ghalib.

lines: Tujhe hum wali samajhte jo na baada-khwaar hota
couplets.en: We would take you for a saint if you did not drink.
